title: I'm 28 today
summary: On his 28th birthday, Jason remembers a childhood fear of not belonging, a painful career exit, and the friends and small moments that make life feel beautiful.

portal.scene: Jason looks through an open window while friends gather around a 28th-birthday cake, surrounded by photographs, music and keepsakes.
portal.motif: The open window and birthday table
